name: USD/JPY Rate Differential: Changes-Based Correlations & OLS Fair Value
description: Extended USD/JPY rate differential analysis with two components: (1) Changes-based correlation analysis computing rolling 60d and 252d Pearson correlations between daily, weekly (5d), and monthly (21d) changes in the US-Japan 10Y yield spread and USD/JPY returns; (2) OLS fair value model using expanding-window regression of USD/JPY on the rate differential, with deviation tracking and 252-day z-score for mean-reversion signals. Data: USD/JPY FX, US 10Y (DGS10), Japan 10Y (IRLTLT01JPM156N).
source:
# USD/JPY Rate Differential: Changes-Based Correlations & OLS Fair Value
# ============================================================================
# Data: USD/JPY, US 10Y yield (DGS10), Japan 10Y yield (IRLTLT01JPM156N)
# Part 1: Rolling correlations of daily/weekly/monthly CHANGES (not levels)
# Part 2: Expanding OLS fair value, deviation, and z-score

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src_fx = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src_fx.c

# US 10-Year Treasury Yield
yield_us_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
yield_us = ffill(yield_us_raw.result)

# Japan 10-Year Government Bond Yield
yield_jp_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
yield_jp = ffill(yield_jp_raw.result)

# Rate differential (US minus Japan)
rate_diff = yield_us - yield_jp

# Bar timestamps for time-series charts
ts = index().value

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: CHANGES-BASED SERIES
# ============================================================================

# Daily changes
daily_rd_chg = rate_diff - (rate_diff >> 1)
daily_fx_logret = ln(close_fx / (close_fx >> 1))

# Weekly changes (5-day differences)
weekly_rd_chg = rate_diff - (rate_diff >> 5)
weekly_fx_logret = ln(close_fx / (close_fx >> 5))

# Monthly changes (21-day differences)
monthly_rd_chg = rate_diff - (rate_diff >> 21)
monthly_fx_logret = ln(close_fx / (close_fx >> 21))

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATIONS (60d and 252d) FOR EACH HORIZON
# ============================================================================

# Daily changes correlations
corr_daily_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=daily_rd_chg, y=daily_fx_logret)
corr_daily_252d = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=daily_rd_chg, y=daily_fx_logret)

# Weekly changes correlations
corr_weekly_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=weekly_rd_chg, y=weekly_fx_logret)
corr_weekly_252d = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=weekly_rd_chg, y=weekly_fx_logret)

# Monthly changes correlations
corr_monthly_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=monthly_rd_chg, y=monthly_fx_logret)
corr_monthly_252d = rolling_corr(window=252, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=monthly_rd_chg, y=monthly_fx_logret)

# ============================================================================
# PART 2: OLS FAIR VALUE MODEL (Expanding-window approximation)
# ============================================================================

# Expanding OLS: USD/JPY = intercept + slope * rate_diff
# Using engle_granger with large window (2520 ~10 years) to approximate expanding
ols = engle_granger(window=2520)(y=close_fx, x=rate_diff)
ols_slope = ols.hedge_ratio
ols_intercept = ols.intercept

# Fair value and deviation
fair_value = ols_intercept + ols_slope * rate_diff
deviation = close_fx - fair_value

# Z-score of deviation (252-day rolling window)
dev_zscore = zscore(window=252)(deviation)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: Rolling Correlation - Daily Changes
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation: Daily Changes in Rate Diff vs USD/JPY Returns',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    category='1. Daily Changes Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252-Day', color=Color.Cyan, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='+0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.3, title='-0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_daily_60d, corr_daily_252d))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: Rolling Correlation - Weekly Changes
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation: Weekly (5d) Changes in Rate Diff vs USD/JPY Returns',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    category='2. Weekly Changes Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252-Day', color=Color.Cyan, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='+0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.3, title='-0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_weekly_60d, corr_weekly_252d))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: Rolling Correlation - Monthly Changes
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling Correlation: Monthly (21d) Changes in Rate Diff vs USD/JPY Returns',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    category='3. Monthly Changes Correlation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60-Day', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252-Day', color=Color.Cyan, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.3, title='+0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.3, title='-0.3', color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(corr_monthly_60d, corr_monthly_252d))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 4: USD/JPY Actual vs OLS Fair Value (scatter-like: x=rate_diff)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY vs OLS Fair Value (by Rate Differential)',
    x_axis_label='Rate Differential (%)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    category='4. OLS Fair Value Model',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Actual USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='OLS Fair Value', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=4
)(x_values=rate_diff, y_values=(close_fx, fair_value))

# ============================================================================
# CHART 5: Fair Value Deviation (over/undervaluation in yen)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY Deviation from OLS Fair Value (Yen)',
    y_axis_label='Deviation (Yen)',
    category='5. Fair Value Deviation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Deviation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Fair Value', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=5
)(x_values=ts, y_values=deviation)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 6: Z-Score of Deviation (252-day rolling)
# ============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Fair Value Deviation Z-Score (252-Day Rolling)',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    category='6. Deviation Z-Score',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Muted, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=1.5, title='+1.5σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-1.5, title='-1.5σ', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    order=6
)(x_values=ts, y_values=dev_zscore)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 7: Summary Statistics Table
# ============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='USD/JPY Fair Value & Correlation Summary',
        row_size=8,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=[
            'Current Rate Differential (%)',
            'OLS Fair Value (USD/JPY)',
            'Current USD/JPY',
            'Deviation from Fair Value (Yen)',
            'Deviation Z-Score',
            'Daily Changes Corr (60d)',
            'Weekly Changes Corr (60d)',
            'Monthly Changes Corr (60d)'
        ],
        col_headers=['Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='7. Summary'
)(rate_diff, fair_value, close_fx, deviation, dev_zscore, corr_daily_60d, corr_weekly_60d, corr_monthly_60d)
